relationships.subject: ACC glutamatergic neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Glutamatergic neurons originating from the ACC exhibited predominant innervation patterns targeting the thalamic and hypothalamic regions

relationships.subject: ACC glutamatergic neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Our neuroanatomical analysis using sagittal and coronal brain sections showed consistent projections of glutamatergic neurons from ACC to BLA.

relationships.subject: ACC glutamatergic neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Neuroanatomical tracing revealed that glutamatergic neurons projected to the p1PAG, PAG, and superior colliculus (SC).

key_findings: ACC, MCC and PCC glutamatergic neurons share a conserved projection architecture via corpus callosum, internal capsule and cerebral peduncle, with subregion-specific differences.
ACC projects to BLA, thalamus, PAG; MCC and PCC do not project to BLA.
